method: All eight final PNGs opened with view_image; inspected titles, legends, axes, uncertainty bands, real traces and matching model identities.

observations.Hb_S_mean.png: S16 has rising HbO and falling HbR conditional means; S59 reverses these trends. S127 has an upward HbR mean. S29 target mean is almost flat. Candidate and parent largely agree; candidate superiority is not universal across individual code means.
observations.Hb_O_mean.png: O16 has jointly rising color means; O82 jointly declining means, with much larger HbR slope. O3 has a curved rising HbR mean. Candidate O16/O82 HbR amplitudes still underrepresent target trends; O3 is closer than parent in visible endpoints.
observations.Hb_S_centered.png: All individual target patches and complete range retained. Extreme traces compress the mean; separate mean/P10-P90 view resolves this without removing traces from the overview.
observations.Hb_O_centered.png: Extreme HbO target trajectories retained; HbR displayed on separate axes. Target means and decoded means smooth inside the two-second patch.
observations.Hb_S_raw.png: Original levels and dispersion retained; conditional means differ between codes and chromophores.
observations.Hb_O_raw.png: Strong O82 HbR downward trajectory and O16 upward trajectory retained with native frozen training scaling, without forcing color anticorrelation.
observations.Hb_S_slopes.png: S29 HbO mixes 69 rising, 90 falling and 30 near-zero training patches. Other codes still contain opposite-sign tails; histogram counts and statistics agree.
observations.Hb_O_slopes.png: O16 HbR has 34 rising training patches; O82 HbR 38 declining. O112 HbO mixes 57 rising, 36 falling and 9 near-zero.

readability: Chinese glyphs, legends, units and panel identities legible at full size; no clipping detected. Individual panel scaling and patch weighting explicitly stated.
interpretation: Descriptive training-assignment patterns on the existing four-subject panel. Full sequence context participates in decoding; no isolated-token or independent-subject inference.
preliminary_export: ../token_patterns_hbo_hbr_20261113_v1 retained; v2 adds separate mean-band detail pages.
